messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate from gateway->ingress in eu-west-2. Alerts firing: gw-5xx-rate, request-timeout-spike. Root: 2251700000
oncall-anna: I'm on it, grabbing context. Any customer-impact updates?
sre-michael: seeing 502/504 from nginx ingress to backend pool. Error budget burn ~3% in last 5m.
eng-infra-lee: logs for the requests are sparse — gateway isn't propagating x-request-id for some routes. Trace sampling also low (0.5%).
observability-kim: confirming — trace/span ids missing for ~70% of the failed requests. Likely instrumented but header lost at the edge.
support-ali: Customer queue shows increased errors for embed API calls from one enterprise account, CS is alerted and triaging. No escalations yet.
oncall-anna: primary goal: reduce customer errors quickly, then fix observability. Ideas?
sre-michael: short-term mitigation: route the affected traffic to the secondary pool (same code) where x-request-id header is preserved. That should cut errors. Can we update routing?
eng-infra-lee: we can add a traffic-split tag to the gateway rule. Pushing a small routing change now. 
eng-infra-lee: (deploy-bot) deploy started: gateway-route-split v2 -> 2251700045
eng-infra-lee: done. traffic now 30% to fallback pool.
observability-kim: still missing traces for failures on the fallback pool too. Looks like we need stopgap instrumentation to correlate without request-id.
product-jess: prioritize correlation for impacted customers — we need to know affected requests within 10m windows.
sre-michael: Proposed stopgap: inject temporary structured logs at the gateway sidecar with a short-lived local request UUID and response code, plus the first 200 bytes of backend error. That will let us correlate with ingress logs and SRE queries. Short TTL (1h) for the logs.
oncall-anna: good. How invasive is the change?
eng-infra-lee: minimal — sidecar supports dynamic log rules via /admin/log-rules. I can push a rule that logs: {local_req_id, route, status, backend_err_snippet}.
eng-infra-lee: pushing rule now:
```
POST /admin/log-rules
{
  "name": "temp-req-correlation",
  "match": "route =~ '^/v1/embeddings' && status >= 500",
  "log": ["local_req_id","route","status","backend_err_snippet(200)"],
  "ttl": 3600
}
```
eng-infra-lee: rule applied at 2251700130.
observability-kim: seeing the new logs in the ephemeral-log stream. local_req_id present, but we still need to tie to traces for postmortem.
sre-michael: increase trace sampling for the gateway for 15 minutes: set sampling to 20% for gateway service. That should capture some of the failed flows.
observability-kim: setting trace sampling now. (observability-bot) sampling-change: gateway->20% for 15m at 2251700185
support-ali: CS reporting error rate dropped ~40% after routing change. Customers see partial recovery.
product-jess: good — message CS to communicate partial mitigation and we are working on root cause.
oncall-anna: what's root cause hypothesis? header strip? misconfigured plugin? recent deploy?
eng-infra-lee: quick grep shows a recent CDN config change rolled back some header forwarding rules on 2251699000 — looks correlated. I flagged the CDN team.
sre-michael: action items: 1) leave sampling/logging for 15m; 2) keep traffic split until header fix validated; 3) CDN rollback patch from CDN team; 4) follow-up postmortem on missing observability.
observability-kim: I'll capture the ephemeral logs and push into a temporary index with tag incident=2251700000 for quick querying.
eng-infra-lee: CDN team confirms they pushed an edge rule that removed forwarded headers for certain cache profiles. They are rolling forward a fix now (cdn-bot): fix-deploy 2251700300
eng-infra-lee: CDN rollback applied 2251700320. Preliminary checks show x-request-id being propagated again.
sre-michael: rolling traffic back to 100% in 5m to validate.
eng-infra-lee: routing restored 2251700400 -> traffic 100% to primary.
observability-kim: traces coming back, correlation with local_req_id works. We can map failed requests to real trace IDs now.
support-ali: CS reports customers seeing normal service. No ongoing escalations.
oncall-anna: closing the pager in 30m if stable. Great coordination — please add notes to the incident ticket: include the CDN config change, temporary logging rule, sampling bump, and routing split.
product-jess: one follow-up for product: evaluate adding synthetic tests to catch header propagation on deploys.
observability-kim: postmortem notes: observability gap due to header loss at CDN; stopgap instrumentation (local_req_id logs + sampling bump) enabled fast correlation; action: enforce header-preservation tests in CI and add canary that validates x-request-id flow for edge changes.
oncall-anna: thanks team. I'll file the follow-up and hand off to the oncall rotation. :thumbsup:
